name: capability fidelity
wording: a capability reaches the harness at the highest fidelity the harness offers: its own native facility first, then cratylus's own extension to the harness, and prose only where neither is possible; a skill carries only when to reach for a capability, never a reimplementation of it in prose, so agents call a capability as a tool rather than follow instructions about it.
